title: Triggers: a History list of every firing and whether context dropped afterwards, kept for one week
summary: The Triggers panel now ends with a one-week History of every firing (trigger, terminal, percent, recipients, delivery) with a follow-up line when a recipient's context drops, a trigger filter and Clear history, kept in one app-wide file in Maestro's app data.

deferred.what: trigger_history.rs load_from treats any read failure other than 'file not found' (a permission or sharing error while another process holds the file) as an empty history, and append_to then saves only the new entry, so one transient read error during a firing silently wipes the whole week's history
deferred.why: Needs a decision on which errors refuse the write and a way to simulate a read failure in tests
